description: Check the topology before generate_script. Errors mean the PTBuilder script would fail or abort (e.g. PORT_KIND_MISMATCH, CABLE_INCOMPATIBLE, DUPLICATE_PORT, IOS_ON_NON_IOS) and block generate_script; warnings mean it may not work as intended in Packet Tracer (e.g. UNVERIFIED_PORT, CABLE_SUSPICIOUS, GATEWAY_NOT_IN_SUBNET, ISOLATED_DEVICE). Each issue has a code and a fix.
name: validate_config
title: Validate topology
